disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment, without legal excuse, of any construction project or operation undertaken by the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment, without legal excuse, of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project with reasonable diligence, causing material injury.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence, thereby causing material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the parties to the contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate violation of building laws or regulations of the state or political subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate violation of the building laws or regulations of the state or of any political subdivision thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay moneys due for materials or services when the contractor has capacity to pay.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any moneys when due for any materials free from defect, or services rendered in connection with the persons operations as a contractor when the person has the capacity to pay

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license or in connection with official licensing matters

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of this article or the rules of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of this article or the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or acting under another person's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or as a contractor by a person other than the person to whom the license is issued except as an employee of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully acting to evade this article by aiding or abetting an unlicensed person, combining with unlicensed person, allowing license to be used by unlicensed person, or assigning/transferring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting with the intent to evade the provisions of this article by: (i) Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this article; (ii) combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person to perform an unauthorized act; (iii) allowing a license to be used by an unlicensed person; or (iv) attempting to assign, transfer, or otherwise dispose of a license or permitting the unauthorized use thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act in the capacity as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act in the capacity as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing work not commensurate with the general standard of the specific contractor classification or below applicable building/construction code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing work which is not commensurate with a general standard of the specific classification of contractor or which is below a building or construction code adopted by the municipality or county in which the work is performed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing a person or persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work as required by §30-42-10.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work in accordance with 30-42-10 of this code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to abide by an order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to abide by an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board.

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" means a person who in any capacity for compensation, other than as an employee of another, undertakes, offers to undertake, purports to have the capacity to undertake, or submits a bid to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck, or demolish any building, highway, road, railroad, structure, or excavation associated with a project, development, or improvement, or to do any part thereof, including the erection of scaffolding or other structures or works in connection therewith, where the cost of the undertaking is $5,000 or more for residential work or $25,000 or more for commercial work.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The contractors license number shall be included in all contracting advertisements and all fully executed and binding contracts.

contract_must_be_written.quote: No person licensed under the provisions of this article may perform contracting work of an aggregate value of $10,000 or more, including materials and labor, without a written contract, setting forth a description and cost of the work to be performed, signed by the licensee and the person for whom the work is to be performed.

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: After the effective date of this article no municipality, local government, or county may require any additional occupational license or other evidence of competence as a contractor from any person, firm, or corporation who or which holds a valid and current license issued pursuant to this article, as a condition precedent to permission for the performance of contractor work in such municipality, local government jurisdiction, or county.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A license issued under the provisions of this article expires one year from the date on which it is issued.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
